result.detail: Self-serve auth: per-account API keys (Bearer) and OAuth 2.1 for Claude/ChatGPT MCP. Docs mention no app review, approval, listing, or install/user cap. Limits are per account (e.g. 200 req/min Starter Monthly), shared across keys and OAuth tokens. Claude/ChatGPT MCP guides not read.
result.quote: Authentication: OAuth 2.1 (Claude, ChatGPT) or an API key sent as a Bearer token (OpenAI Agent Builder and other clients).
